t: Moksha is not a place to be reached but the realisation of God, here, in this human life.
Heaven is nothing but a pure heart in which God is experienced.
Ours is to pray, to give or not is God's discretion.
Friendship should be based on giving and not expecting.
Friendship is destroyed by imposing and expecting. It is really built up in freedom.
Really speaking, God alone is our best friend.
Character is what we really are and conduct is how we appear to others.
If one is cent-per-cent sure about a thing being right, one must have the courage to follow it.
Emotion is mostly biological and leads to 'excitement', while genuine feeling proceeds from the most tranquil heart and leads to constructive steady action.
Depending on anyone whom you think to be a wise person for clearing your thoughts, your vision, does not make you cowardly. It rather makes you wiser and wiser.
We have to restrain impulsive action and practise action guided by reason.
The purpose of friendship is to complement, supplement and help each other to attain perfection.
Select your friends very carefully in such a way that your merits get a boost and not the demerits or evil passions.
It is the attempt to turn the light towards its source within.
Desires do not end when we try to satisfy them; they increase like fire fed with fuel.
God is ever present concealed in the cave of the heart of every living being.
When we respect anyone we respect God reflected in that person.
The reason why we feel this futility etc. is that we are dealing with mere shadows.
When we observe really great men, we see that they are hardly aware of their bodies !
Each soul is potentially divine; stand on your own legs.
The very purpose of education is inculcation and strengthening of values OR to make life more valuable and worthwhile.

If we run after enjoyments, we shall not have the power to improve ourselves and those enjoyments will also slip away from us like shadows, but if we continually struggle for self-improvement, then happiness will follow.
Of course, all our ideas of God are hazy in the beginning.
Youth, in contrast with childhood and old age, is defined as that phase of life when we can think and also act up to our thinking.
Doing good to others is holy action; while giving trouble to others is sin.
Friendship is sustained by each one struggling to be a better individual and by always helping each other.
Mind is filled with vigour, strength and confidence; gets clarity of vision, gets controlled, steady and active, concentrated and focused.
If character is perfect, it reflects in good behaviour.
To the discriminating intellect God alone has ‘value’.
So various paths are necessary and valid
मानने से क्या होगा? सोचने दो, समझने दो, दृढ़ता से पकड़ने दो, तभी तो काम आवेगा जीवन में।
पर स्वरूप को समझो और स्वरूप के प्रकाश में अपने सारे अनुभवों को, सिद्धान्तों को परखो-बदलो।
हमें पीलिया है तो सब पीला ही दिखेगा!
उसकी स्पष्ट प्रतीति तो ईश्वरकृपा, गुरुकृपा से ही होती है।
जिस प्रकार दीपक अपनेही प्रकाशमें स्वयंको देखता है - उसी प्रकार।
उसे सिखाइए कि हारने में सुघड़ता कैसी दिख सकती है और जब वह जीते तो जीत का आनन्द लेना भी सिखाइए।
ऐसे जीवन को जीने के लिए श्रद्धा, प्यार और धैर्य की जरूरत पड़ेगी।
और एक बात यह कि महापुरुषों का सङ्ग ईश्वर कृपा से मिलेगा तो उसी के लिए ईश्वर से व्याकुल होकर प्रार्थना करते रहो।
उनमें जाति, विद्या, रूप, कुल, धन, क्रिया आदि को लेकर कोई भेद नहीं होता।
उस आत्माका ध्यान करने पर साधक शोक नहीं करता, और वह शरीरके रहने पर भी मुक्त हुआ ही शरीर छोड़ने पर भी मोक्ष ही पाता है।
जिसका जो अभाव वह कैसे भी पूरा करना ही होगा!
मैं ही तो सब कुछ हूँ - सूक्ष्म रूप में।
‘हमें सब कुछ पता है’ यह बहुत बड़ा अज्ञान है;
परन्तु, वह भक्ति तो ‘इस’ के प्रति परमप्रेमरूप है।
पढ़ना भर थोड़े ही है। ‘पीना’ है,
